info.title: AiCar Provider API
info.description: Local Car CRS sandbox. Use a server-issued car provider bearer token. Search the assigned operator inventory, quote seats, hold, confirm and retrieve tickets. Booking and refund amounts are sandbox records in INR paise. Examples use synthetic values; substitute IDs, seats and future dates from your own inventory.

get.description: Sorted city names from active routes for the operator assigned to your token.
Filter active routes by city name. Matching ignores letter case.
Results include future scheduled trips open for booking with enough available passenger seats.

post.description: Use different cities. The return date must be on or after the outbound date. Confirm timing for your selected pair with a fare quote.

get.description: Use the trip ID from search.
Choose an available passenger seat with isBookable=true. Driver seats cannot be held.

post.description: For round trips include both return fields. Amounts are in INR paise. A quote does not reserve seats.
Hold duration defaults to 600 seconds. Save holdId and expiresAt.
Save both hold IDs. The combined expiry is the earlier leg expiry.

get.description: Use the holdId string from the hold response.

delete.description: released=false indicates that the hold was already inactive.

post.description: Send holdId or outboundHoldId and one passenger per held seat. ROUND_TRIP also requires returnHoldId. Supply returnPassengers if seats differ. Retry the identical body with the same idempotencyKey. A supplied amount must match the authoritative fare.

get.description: Use either the booking ID or PNR returned by confirmation.
Each confirmed leg has a ticket with passenger and seat details.

post.description: The fee depends on time to the earliest departure. The quote does not cancel the booking.
Cancels the booking across its legs and records the sandbox refund outcome.

get.description: Read paymentStatus and leg statuses after cancellation.
